essence: Offering flowers born from girikarṇī certainly subjugates brahmins.
By offering mālatī flowers, one brings their sons under control.
Offering pungent-mixed mustard seeds instantly subjugates kings.
By oblation one certainly subjugates men, women, and kings.
Within a year the practitioner becomes fortunate and conquers kings.
